lines.t: Shadows crawl...
bells toll slow...
Thunder cracks,
ghost winds blow...
“Therefore concerning these holidays of men, which God hates...”
The beat drops... BOOM!
Masks on faces, all tricks, no treats,
Dancing with demons in them haunted streets.
Candy in bags
but the souls go cheap,
While the Shepherd still cries
for his lost sheep.
For one who truly
loves Him seeks to
please Him,—
Yeah, not the world or its mockin’ scenery.
He said He dwells in those
who flee,
Run from them holidays, let righteousness and truth
be what you seek.
They lightin’ fires in the night,
But the Word calls us to light—
A flame that burns with holy sight,
Runnin’ from this holiday
into His might.
Break the spell, let the silence speak,
We don’t chase no Halloween.
From death’s parade, we turn, we flee—
Despisin’ holidays of men,
He said depart, don’t blend in..
Let the division be made clear.
Skeletons dancin’ in the neon grave,
While so many souls forget Who gave.
Doctrines of men, yeah, it tastes so sweet,
But it’s ashes under His holy feet.
“And any who reject My Word, in favor of the doctrines and traditions of men, embrace that which runs contrary to Me,”
Yep, That’s a warning straight from God you just heard.
Traditions twist what’s pure and true,
They embrace what runs contrary to Him.
Let those who say they know Him—
Pick up that cross, and follow…
If they don’t…
then mark the weight,
The day will come,
they seal their fate.
Let love divide, let truth remain,
We walk through fire, past worldly chains.
“Let all who’ve received
the love of he truth
depart from them...”
Break the spell, let the silence speak,
We don’t chase no hollow week.
From death’s parade, we turn, we flee,
Despising holidays of men,
He said depart, don’t blend in.
Let the division be made clear.
[Outro]
*The lights go out.*
